## Summary

PR #610 was `mergeable_state: dirty` due to two purely-additive conflicts against fresh `main` (created by PR #614 merging in the meantime): `PROGRESS.md` and `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml`, both log/registry files where each branch had appended its own entry. Verified this by actually merging in an isolated worktree rather than assuming — no real logic conflict existed; `construction-boq-import-service.ts`/`.test.ts` (PR #614's change) auto-merged cleanly with zero overlap against PR #610's sales-pipeline files.

Resolved by keeping both sides' content in full, verified with `tsc --noEmit` (clean) and the full test suite (2322 pass, 0 fail), then pushed the merge commit to PR #610's own branch. `gh api .../pulls/610` now confirms `mergeable: true` (previously `false`/`dirty`). Re-registered the claim in `ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` and re-swept CI: everything now passes except a pre-existing `Terminology Guardrail Check` failure (already disclosed by an earlier PR #610 fix-forward session, in files untouched by this merge) and an unrelated Vercel rate-limit — both documented in `PROGRESS.md` as out of scope for this task, not fixed here.

Task complete. PR #610's merge conflict was already resolved and pushed in prior invocations (sha `cd3db8e6`); this invocation just re-polled CI to completion — `Build` and `Analyze` finished and now pass, leaving only two pre-existing, unrelated failures (`Terminology Guardrail Check`, `Vercel` rate-limit) that were already documented as out of scope. PROGRESS.md is updated and pushed marking the task done.
